story.so_that: I can durably automate complete multi-step workflows of agentic action
story.as_a: Software Engineer, and AI Process Designer
story.i_want: a working example of the Story Analysis Workflow of the SDLC process using a publicly available workflow engine

related_acceptance_criteria.criterion: A working example of the Story Analysis Workflow of the SDLC process using Cadence
The implemented workflow is documented and can be used by others
The implemented workflow demonstrates flow of agentic actions, including tool calls and state management, retry-loops, and punching out to the human in cases of ambiguity or uncertainty
Workflow actions are auditable and traceable after workflow completion
Agentic Workflow actions affect the repository state (e.g., create files, update documentation)
Workflow is repeatable, producing similar results when given the same inputs
Happy path: all SDLC skill Activities succeed on first attempt with no human escalation needed
Error handling: an Activity fails repeatedly and exhausts its RetryPolicy
Human escalation timeout: no human responds to an escalation Signal within a bounded wait
Domain/task-list scoping: only Workers and clients configured for the workflow's Cadence domain and task list can start, signal, or execute it
An analysis that fails grade-story-analysis's pass threshold is repaired via repair-story-analysis and re-graded
The grade-repair cycle is bounded to a maximum of 3 attempts

related_edge_cases.criterion: Empty or null story document input
Very large story document exceeds Cadence input/Activity payload size limits
Special characters/unicode in the story text
First-time use: no Cadence domain registered yet
Concurrent workflow executions for the same story
Worker crash mid-Activity and workflow resumption via replay
Duplicate/idempotent Activity execution due to retries

steps.description: Write unit tests for the repair skill, Workflow state, and Signal/Query logic
Write integration tests for the happy path and grade-repair loop against the local server
Write E2E tests that trigger a run and inspect cadence workflow describe and the Cadence Web UI
Run the full test suite and fix failures
artifacts: tests/CI results / local test run output
